arStrings.szText: {c_important}Bone Spear{/c} breaks into {c_number}{SF_26}{/c} piercing bone shards when it is destroyed, dealing {c_number}{payload:DAMAGE_BONESHARD}{/c} damage each.

{c_important}Bone Spear{/c} becomes a {c_important}Blood{/c} Skill that deals {c_number}{payload:DAMAGE_BLOOD}{/c} damage.

Casting {c_important}Bone Spear{/c} consumes a nearby Corpse and conjures a second {c_important}Bone Spear{/c} from it, dealing {c_number}[{SF_6}*100|%|]{/c} of normal damage.

{c_important}Bone Spear{/c} becomes a {c_important}Darkness{/c} Skill that deals {c_number}{payload:DAMAGE_SHADOW}{/c} Shadow damage.

Instead of piercing through, {c_important}Bone Spear{/c} forks into {c_number}2{/c} piercing spears each time it hits an enemy or wall, up to {c_number}{SF_39}{/c} times.
{c_important}Bone Spear{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_9*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage to the first enemy hit.
{c_important}Bone Spear's{/c} Essence cost is reduced by {c_number}{SF_11}{/c}.
{c_important}Bone Spear{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_16*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage per enemy pierced{if:SF_12} or forked{/if}, up to {c_number}[SF_17*100|x%|]{/c}.
{c_important}Bone Spear{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_14}*100|%x|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Damage per stack of {c_important}{u}Resolve{/c}{/u}, up to {c_number}[{SF_15}*100|%x|]{/c}.
